newsitem.title: USA: Energen unit buys stake in Cotton Valley.
newsitem.headline: Energen unit buys stake in Cotton Valley.

text.p: Energen Corp's exploration and production subsidiary Taurus Exploration Inc has paid $16 mllion for a nine percent stake in Sonat Inc's and United Meridian Corp's joint venture in the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend.
The company said on Monday that Taurus's new joint venture covers a leasehold of 195,000 gross acres and drilling is under way on the joint venture's first well, the Ryon No. 1.
"If successful, the Ryon No. 1 will extend Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend gas production some 45 miles to the northeast of current drilling activity," Taurus said.
The joint venture will complete 3-D seismic studies on 70 percent of its acreage by the end of this year and the remainder in 1998.

Under a five year plan, Taurus will invest between fiscal more than $400 million in the acquisition of producing between 1996 and fiscal 2000 and more than $100 million in exploration and development.
In the first 18 months of the plan, Taurus has invested $200 million in acquisitions, $10 million in their development and $26 million in exploration and related development spending.
This has resulted in additions of 415 billion cubic feet equivelent of natural gas reserves. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
